attachments.title: <https://github.com/pystardust/ytfzf/blob/master/docs/INSTALL.md | INSTALL.md>
attachments.text:
*Installation*
*Dependencies*

_Fzf is optional, you can use an external menu (like dmenu) with the `-D` option (no thumbnail support)._

• <https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv|`mpv`>
• <https://github.com/ytdl-org/youtube-dl|`youtube-dl`>
• <https://github.com/stedolan/jq|`jq`> - _to parse json_
• <https://github.com/junegunn/fzf|`fzf`> (Optional if using: `dmenu, rofi`) - _for menu_
• <https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libnotify|`notify-send`> (Optional) - _for desktop notifications_
• <https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/html_node/shuf-invocation.html|GNU `shuf`> or <https://github.com/ibara/shuf|ISC `shuf`> (Optional) - _for selecting random videos_
• <https://github.com/seebye/ueberzug|`ueberzug`> (Optional) - _for thumbnails_
• other thumbnail options
    • <https://github.com/hpjansson/chafa|`chafa`>
    • <https://github.com/posva/catimg|`catimg`>
    • <https://github.com/cslarsen/jp2a|`jp2a`>

> be sure to export `YTFZF_THUMB_DISP_METHOD` in your shell rc or `thumb_disp_method` in the <conf.sh|config> when not using ueberzug

> Thumbnails only work with `fzf` as of now.

• *Arch based*
    
    ```
    sudo pacman -S jq mpv youtube-dl fzf
    
    ```
    
    > For thumbnails
    
    ```
    sudo pacman -S ueberzug
    
    ```
• *Debian based*
    
    ```
    sudo apt install jq mpv youtube-dl fzf
    
    ```
    
    > For thumbnails
    
    ```
    pip install ueberzug
    
    ```
    
    _Note youtube-dl is usually outdated in debian repos, I suggest getting it from <https://github.com/ytdl-org/youtube-dl|youtube-dl github>_
• *FreeBSD*
    
    ```
    pkg install jq mpv youtube_dl fzf libnotify shuf
    
    ```
    
    > For thumbnails
    
    ```
    pkg install --glob "py3*-ueberzug"
    
    ```
• *Guix*
    
    Ytfzf can be deployed on any GNU/Linux Systems, using <https://guix.gnu.org|Guix>.
    
    To install in the user's default-profile, do `guix package --install ytfzf`
    
    To test without installation, do `guix environment --pure --ad-hoc ytfzf curl nss-certs`
• *MacOS*
    
    ```
    brew install jq mpv youtube-dl fzf
    
    ```
    
    _At the moment thumbnail previews aren't working on MacOS_

*Installation-Options*

1. *Installation by direct download*
    
    ```
    curl -sL "<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pystardust/ytfzf/master/ytfzf>" | sudo tee /usr/bin/ytfzf >/dev/null && sudo chmod 755 /usr/bin/ytfzf
    ```
    
    _MacOS users might need to change their installation path from `/usr/bin/` to `/usr/local/bin/`_
2. *Arch users can install ytfzf from the <https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/ytfzf/|AUR>*
    
    ```
    yay -S ytfzf
    
    ```
    
    Or alternatively from <https://github.com/JojiiOfficial|@JojiiOfficials> <https://repo.jojii.de|pacman repository>
3. *FreeBSD users can install ytfzf as a binary package with <https://www.freshports.org/multimedia/ytfzf/|pkg(8)>*
    
    ```
    pkg instal ytfzf
    
    ```
    
    Or alternatively, build the port from source
    
    ```
    make -C /usr/ports/multimedia/ytfzf install
    
    ```
4. *Gentoo users can install ytfzf from the <https://github.com/VTimofeenko/nitratesky|nitratesky> overlay*
    
    ```
    eselect repository enable nitratesky
    emerge -a1 net-misc/ytfzf
    
    ```
5. *Debian and Ubuntu LTS can get it from <https://mpr.hunterwittenborn.com/|MPR>*
    
    ```
    git clone <https://mpr.hunterwittenborn.com/ytfzf.git>
    makedeb -i
    
    ```

*Installation by cloning the repository*

```
git clone <https://github.com/pystardust/ytfzf>
cd ytfzf
```

• *Install with the Makefile*

```
sudo make install
```

• *Uninstall with the Makefile*

```
sudo make uninstall
```
